get.description: Every person saved under this key, oldest first.

post.description: Adds a person under this key (up to 10) with a new server-made ID.

delete.description: Erases one person's numbers and every plan saved from them.

MatchInput.title: MatchInput
MatchInput.description: How the employer matches: "match" = `match_per_dollar` for each dollar up to `up_to_rate` of pay.

SaveRunRequest.title: SaveRunRequest
SaveRunRequest.description:
What the app saves: the inputs of a result it is showing, never its numbers.

The server re-runs the engine from these inputs and stores only its own output.
`input_hash` must match the recomputed hash, which proves the stored run is the
result the user saw.

StoredProfile.title: StoredProfile
StoredProfile.description: The user's saved numbers: the form as entered, and the profile built from it.
